title: Build the Rights-Ledger MVP
goal: Create a structured, internal rights ledger covering every current catalog work and proposed candidate, with separate rights layers, territories, evidence, reviewer, and safe unknown defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger covers all current catalog works and the task-003 proposed candidates.
Each entry separates underlying-work, edition, translation, transcription, and recording rights.
Each entry records territory, source URL, institution, license, contact if known, reviewer, and review/tier tags.
Unverified fields default to unknown and are explicitly non-publishable.
Jurisdiction-sensitive rows (López Velarde, Reyes) carry explicit uncertainty and legal-review flag.
Translation entity records translator and language consultant when a translated/bilingual expression exists.
Ledger is valid JSON validated against its schema.
Critic issues PASS before any use for publication decisions.
No public production files are changed.
